title: ResponseComputer — cascade frequency response for GUI, CMakeLists update
description:
Implement composite frequency-response computation for the parametric cascade and register new DSP sources in CMake. This task is the sole CMakeLists.txt owner in phase b.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/BiquadCoefficients.* magnitude/complex helpers
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.* band parameter accessors
- CMakeLists.txt target_sources for ShredEQ and ShredEQUnitTests (as created in phase a)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §3.5 cascade G_total(w) = 20*log10(|prod H_i|)

Implement Source/DSP/ResponseComputer.h and Source/DSP/ResponseComputer.cpp:
1. Message-thread-safe API: given a snapshot of band parameters (or const ParametricBand/ParametricEQ view), compute composite complex/magnitude response at approximately 512 log-spaced frequency points from a sensible low bound (e.g. 10–20 Hz) to Nyquist for sampleRate.
2. Output buffers for magnitude dB and optional phase degrees/radians into caller-provided spans/arrays (no GUI painting here). Allow preallocated storage inside ResponseComputer constructed/resized off the audio thread; document that compute() must not run on the audio thread if it allocates.
3. Include only enabled, non-bypassed bands. Respect per-band type/slope via BiquadCoefficients cascade design (TPT visual match can approximate with equivalent biquad coefficients of same f/G/Q/type for display).
4. Stereo/mid-side display can start as mono/linked composite; if routing text is needed for GUI later, expose hook parameters only.
5. Update CMakeLists.txt to add the new phase-b DSP sources to plugin and unit-test targets if those targets list sources explicitly:
   - Source/DSP/BiquadCoefficients.cpp
   - Source/DSP/TPTFilter.cpp
   - Source/DSP/ParametricBand.cpp
   - Source/DSP/ResponseComputer.cpp
   Do not remove existing sources; do not add tests/*.cpp for Biquad/Parametric yet (task b.5 owns tests files; list of test sources may wait for b.5 if CMake already uses a glob—prefer explicit append of DSP .cpp only).

Do NOT implement PluginEditor curve painting, do not own unit tests, and do not expand scope beyond CMake source list updates.
acceptance_criteria: ResponseComputer computes composite magnitude response at approximately 512 log-spaced points between a low frequency bound and Nyquist
Composite response follows cascade product of enabled band transfer functions (dB sum of section magnitudes)
CMakeLists.txt lists BiquadCoefficients.cpp, TPTFilter.cpp, ParametricBand.cpp, and ResponseComputer.cpp on the appropriate ShredEQ targets
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: rewrite BiquadCoefficients/TPTFilter/ParametricBand beyond necessary includes from ResponseComputer
remove unrelated existing CMake sources or options

allowed: approximate TPT band visuals with equivalent RBJ coefficients
append DSP cpp files to existing juce_add_plugin and unit-test target_sources
message-thread documentation and optional preallocated work buffers
forbidden: change manufacturer codes or plugin formats
audio-thread heap growth in compute hot path without documentation
